  Everything else is present. Re-read
  the file to pick it up.

  Nothing else is open on my side. The
  three findings most worth carrying
  into the implementation:

  1. detect-gpu has never executed —
     import('detect-gpu') is a bare
     specifier inside a <Script>
     template literal with no import
     map; it throws at resolution
     (measured: Chromium 149 + WebKit
     26.5, with a blob-URL positive
     control) before any network call.
     Removal is a
     zero-behaviour-change cleanup,
     not a perf win.
  2. The brief's "<1 px per frame" is 
     off by ~10× — real figure is 12.5
     device px/frame peak at 60 fps /
     10 s sweep. 30 fps still 
     defensible on angular velocity
     (4–8 °/s); 20 fps is not.
  3. It's 50 beams, not 51 —
     EXPECTED_PATH_COUNT = 51 vs 50
     entries, so the schema guard
     warns on every load; and mobile
     currently renders 34, so "all
     beams everywhere" is a content
     increase.
  ⎿  TeammateIdle hook stopped 
     continuation: Idle teammate 
     auto-shutdown (work preserved in 
     refs/wip/LAST + /tmp/*.patch; 
     pane closed via it2/tmux)
